functional.title: Endpoint ownership
functional.definition: Implement dual proof via key signature and a domain-served nonce, verify exact origin and time window, persist attestation expiry and rotation.

functional.title: Consent and suite freezing
functional.definition: Import consented redacted invoices, create buyer-only truth records, document allowed processors and hash a versioned sample manifest and normalization configuration.

functional.title: Budgeted experiment scheduling
functional.definition: Expand the provider-by-sample matrix, reserve per-provider authorized spend and enforce bounded dispatch concurrency. Store completion, quota and timeout reasons separately.

functional.title: Paid execution and receipt matching
functional.definition: Build OCR adapter contracts and receipt capture, bind transport and credential use to the declared provider, and record receipt provenance and attempt latency.

functional.title: Typed scoring and acceptance
functional.definition: Implement manifest-pinned Unicode, monetary and date normalization, mandatory-field acceptance, timeout handling and interpretable field errors.

functional.title: Comparison reports
functional.definition: Generate buyer-private reports with workload, dated sample size, confusion details, cost per accepted invoice, latency percentiles with sample count, and coverage thresholds.

functional.title: Audit, freshness and reruns
functional.definition: Add curve of quality over suite versions, opt-in recurring trials, results export, role-scoped evidence and read-only reconstruction from frozen records.

functional.title: Buyer workflow and acceptance proof
functional.definition: Build the procurement-to-report UI with consent and cap review, coverage filters, small-sample notices and the two-provider acceptance scenario. Exercise API plus browser from clean storage.

nonfunctional.title: Replayable evidence
nonfunctional.definition: A reviewer can reproduce the outcome from the exact input revision, actor scope, persisted decision and redacted evidence reference after a process restart.

invariants.title: Endpoint ownership
invariants.definition: Both endpoint control and the enrolled principal must match the same nonce and origin.

invariants.title: Consent and suite freezing
invariants.definition: A running trial cannot observe edits to its labels or processor permissions silently.

invariants.title: Budgeted experiment scheduling
invariants.definition: Each provider sees the same frozen sample set; unanswered planned samples remain visible.

invariants.title: Paid execution and receipt matching
invariants.definition: Every reported cost maps to a verified charge for the corresponding trial; uncertainty is explicit.

invariants.title: Typed scoring and acceptance
invariants.definition: Measure extraction against buyer-approved typed labels with fixed denominators.

invariants.title: Comparison reports
invariants.definition: Reports with zero accepted invoices have undefined unit cost; suppressed comparison must explain why.

invariants.title: Audit, freshness and reruns
invariants.definition: Comparisons across different suites or scoring rules cannot appear as a like-for-like trend.

invariants.title: Buyer workflow and acceptance proof
invariants.definition: Every displayed provider claim includes workload, relevant date, observed sample count and evidence scope.
